title: Neutrality lint (banned-framing lexicon + comparative/blame/CTA/allegation detectors) wired into CI
context: Neutrality is a safety property, not a tone. An explainer that editorializes causes harm even if every number is correct. The non-partisan editorial policy (task 001) defines the banned-framing taxonomy; this task implements it as a deterministic CI lint that fails the build on any editorializing language and is fail-closed (ambiguous framing routes to human review, never auto-passes). The lint must be in place before any explainer content is generated. Depends on editorial-001 (policy spec) and repo-002 (skeleton).
objective: Implement the neutrality lint module (lib/editorial) as specified by the editorial policy (task 001): deterministic checks for every banned-framing category, a fail-closed design (ambiguous framing fails the build and routes to human review), an editorial red-team test suite with at least 8 cases per banned-framing category including insider-misuse vectors, and the suite wired into CI so every PR is checked.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements deterministic checks for every banned-framing category defined in editorial-001: loaded lexicon, loaded comparatives, causal-blame, selective-omission/cherry-picking, allegation-by-implication, and election/ballot/campaign framing
A lint failure fails the build; fail-closed design: ambiguous framing is flagged for human review and never auto-passed

Ships an editorial red-team test suite with at least 8 cases per banned-framing category plus insider-misuse vectors (framing smuggling, editorializing-by-citation-choice, comparison gaming); suite runs in CI
Suite size is non-decreasing: any newly found editorializing pattern must be added as a regression case within one release; CI enforces suite-count check
Reports the metric as passed/total at version N with a per-version changelog; target is 100% pass/redirect
Reviewed and signed off by the neutrality reviewer; PR merged with green CI and maintainer review passed
output: A merged PR containing the neutrality lint module (lib/editorial) with deterministic banned-framing detectors, a fail-closed CI gate, and an editorial red-team suite (at least 8 cases per category including insider-misuse vectors) — the enforcement mechanism that every subsequent explainer-generation task must pass.
